b.clean:
Dear Ms. Brant, on behalf of the selection committee, I'm delighted to let you know that your short film The Lantern Keeper has been selected for the Northgate Independent Film Festival this November. It will screen in the animation program on Saturday the 16th at 2:15 p.m., followed by a short Q&A with the other directors in the block. We'd love for you to attend in person, and we can cover two nights of accommodation and up to €400 toward travel.

To confirm, would you send us a screening file by October 20th, along with the high-resolution still, a 50-word synopsis and your preferred pronouns for the program? Our technical coordinator, Perpetuo, will be in touch separately about the file specifications. Congratulations again, and we look forward to welcoming you to the festival. Warm regards, Jolly Mayor, Program Director

b.clean:
Hi, son of a, I've been meaning to write since we got back from the Scotland trip. It was honestly one of the best weeks I've had in years. We did the north coast route in the camper van, which was terrifying on the single-track roads at first, every time a lorry came round a corner I stopped breathing, but by day two I was waving at the passing places like a local. The highlight was a tiny beach near Durnis where we didn't see another person for an entire afternoon.

The low point was the midges. Nobody warned us. Well, everyone warned us, but nobody warned us properly. I think I still have bites on my ankles.

Anyway, I'd love to hear how the move went and whether you've unpacked yet. Are you free for a call next weekend, maybe Saturday morning? Love, Perpetua
